What we clean

  • Every-other-week cleaning

    The same crew every visit, so they learn your house, your pets and your preferences.

    Price it

  • Weekly cleaning

    For busy houses with kids and dogs: floors, kitchen and baths kept ahead of the week.

    Price it

  • Monthly cleaning

    A fuller once-a-month visit for tidy households that want the bathrooms and floors reset.

    Price it

  • Deep clean

    Baseboards, door frames, grout and inside the microwave: the list regular visits do not touch.

    Price it

  • Move-out cleaning for PCS moves

    Military move-out cleans timed around the packers, with photos for your landlord or housing office.

    Price it

  • Move-in cleaning

    Cabinets, closets and appliances wiped out before the moving truck arrives.

    Price it

  • Oven & fridge add-on

    Inside the oven and the fridge cleaned and shelves wiped, added to any visit.

    Price it

  • Inside windows

    Inside glass, sills and tracks cleaned room by room, add it to any visit.

    Price it

    Extra time on stairs, sofas and corners where dog and cat hair piles up.
